# Overview

This document loads pre-computed batch simulation results and generates all
visualizations for the MBBE uncertainty analysis. No heavy simulations are
re-run — only plotting from saved `.jls` files.

# Load Results

```{julia}
#| output: false
include(joinpath(@__DIR__, "common.jl"))

# Resolve results next to this document rather than at an absolute path. The
# previous value pointed at /home/jrun/data/code/teva-olanzapine/..., which is
# both machine-specific and a DIFFERENT project directory from the one these
# files live in, so neither report could render anywhere but one machine.
const RESULTS_DIR = @__DIR__
results = load_all_method_results(dir = RESULTS_DIR)
all_batches  = results.all_batches
all_summary  = results.all_summary
relative_df  = results.relative_df
nothing
```

# Pass Rate Curves with CI Bands

```{julia}
#| label: fig-passrate-ci-bands
#| fig-cap: "BE pass rate (± 95% CI band) across T/R ratios and sample sizes for each uncertainty method."
fig1 = Figure(size = (1400, 900))

for (idx, m) in enumerate(METHODS_LIST)
    row = (idx - 1) ÷ 2 + 1
    col = (idx - 1) % 2 + 1
    ax = Axis(fig1[row, col];
        xlabel = "T/R Ratio",
        ylabel = "BE Pass Rate (%)",
        title  = "$m Method",
        xticks = TR_RATIOS,
        yticks = 0:10:100
    )

    sub = filter(r -> r.method == m, all_summary)
    for (j, n) in enumerate(SAMPLE_SIZES)
        sub_n = sort(filter(r -> r.n_per_arm == n, sub), :tr_ratio)
        nrow(sub_n) == 0 && continue

        band!(ax, sub_n.tr_ratio, sub_n.ci_lo, sub_n.ci_hi;
            color = (SIZE_COLORS[j], 0.15))

        scatterlines!(ax, sub_n.tr_ratio, sub_n.mean_rate;
            label     = "n=$n",
            color     = SIZE_COLORS[j],
            marker    = :circle,
            markersize = 7,
            linewidth = 2
        )
    end

    hlines!(ax, [5.0]; color = :red, linestyle = :dash, linewidth = 1, label = "5% α")
    vlines!(ax, [0.80, 1.25]; color = :gray70, linestyle = :dot, linewidth = 1)

    if idx == 2
        axislegend(ax; position = :rt, labelsize = 9)
    end
end

Label(fig1[0, :], "BE Pass Rate by T/R Ratio and Sample Size (Mean ± 95% CI)"; fontsize = 20)
fig1
```

# Power at T/R = 1.0 with Error Bars

```{julia}
#| label: fig-power-errorbars
#| fig-cap: "Statistical power at T/R = 1.0 by sample size, with 95% CI error bars."
fig2 = Figure(size = (1000, 600))
ax2 = Axis(fig2[1, 1];
    xlabel = "Subjects per Arm",
    ylabel = "Power (%)",
    title  = "Power at T/R = 1.0 ($N_BATCHES Batches × $N_SIMS_PER_BATCH Trials)",
    xticks = SAMPLE_SIZES,
    yticks = 0:10:100
)

for (i, m) in enumerate(METHODS_LIST)
    sub = sort(filter(r -> r.method == m && r.tr_ratio == 1.0, all_summary), :n_per_arm)
    nrow(sub) == 0 && continue
    x_shifted = sub.n_per_arm .+ METHOD_OFFSETS[i]

    errorbars!(ax2, x_shifted, sub.mean_rate,
        sub.mean_rate .- sub.ci_lo, sub.ci_hi .- sub.mean_rate;
        color = METHOD_COLORS[i], linewidth = 1.5, whiskerwidth = 8)

    scatterlines!(ax2, x_shifted, sub.mean_rate;
        label      = m,
        color      = METHOD_COLORS[i],
        marker     = METHOD_SHAPES[i],
        markersize = 12,
        linewidth  = 2
    )
end

hlines!(ax2, [80.0]; color = :gray, linestyle = :dash, linewidth = 1, label = "80% target")
axislegend(ax2; position = :rb)
fig2
```

# Method Comparison Bar Chart

Grouped bar plot at n = 30 per arm, showing all T/R ratios:

```{julia}
#| label: fig-bar-comparison
#| fig-cap: "Method comparison at n = 30 per arm: pass rate with 95% CI error bars."
fig4 = Figure(size = (1200, 600))
ax4 = Axis(fig4[1, 1];
    xlabel = "T/R Ratio",
    ylabel = "BE Pass Rate (%)",
    title  = "Method Comparison at n = 30 per Arm (Mean ± 95% CI)",
    xticks = (1:length(TR_RATIOS), string.(TR_RATIOS)),
    yticks = 0:10:100
)

n_methods = length(METHODS_LIST)
bar_width = 0.8 / n_methods
offsets   = [(i - (n_methods + 1) / 2) * bar_width for i in 1:n_methods]

for (i, m) in enumerate(METHODS_LIST)
    sub = sort(filter(r -> r.method == m && r.n_per_arm == 30, all_summary), :tr_ratio)
    nrow(sub) == 0 && continue
    x_pos = (1:nrow(sub)) .+ offsets[i]

    barplot!(ax4, x_pos, sub.mean_rate;
        width = bar_width * 0.9,
        color = (METHOD_COLORS[i], 0.8),
        label = m
    )
    errorbars!(ax4, x_pos, sub.mean_rate,
        sub.mean_rate .- sub.ci_lo, sub.ci_hi .- sub.mean_rate;
        color = :black, linewidth = 1, whiskerwidth = 4)
end

hlines!(ax4, [5.0]; color = :red, linestyle = :dash, linewidth = 1, label = "5% α")
axislegend(ax4; position = :ct, labelsize = 10)
fig4
```

# Box Plots of Batch Pass Rates

Distribution of batch-level pass rates at T/R = 1.0, showing variability
across macro-replications:

```{julia}
#| label: fig-boxplots
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of batch-level pass rates (200 batches) at T/R = 1.0, by sample size."
fig5 = Figure(size = (1400, 900))

for (idx, m) in enumerate(METHODS_LIST)
    row = (idx - 1) ÷ 2 + 1
    col = (idx - 1) % 2 + 1
    ax = Axis(fig5[row, col];
        xlabel = "Subjects per Arm",
        ylabel = "Batch Pass Rate (%)",
        title  = "$m Method",
        xticks = (1:length(SAMPLE_SIZES), string.(SAMPLE_SIZES)),
        yticks = 0:10:100
    )

    sub = filter(r -> r.method == m && r.tr_ratio == 1.0, all_batches)
    nrow(sub) == 0 && continue

    positions = [findfirst(==(n), SAMPLE_SIZES) for n in sub.n_per_arm]

    boxplot!(ax, positions, sub.pass_rate;
        color = (METHOD_COLORS[idx], 0.6),
        whiskerwidth = 0.5,
        mediancolor  = :black
    )

    hlines!(ax, [80.0]; color = :gray, linestyle = :dash, linewidth = 1)
end

Label(fig5[0, :], "Distribution of Batch Pass Rates at T/R = 1.0 ($N_BATCHES Batches × $N_SIMS_PER_BATCH Trials)"; fontsize = 18)
fig5
```

# Forest Plot — Power at T/R = 1.0

```{julia}
#| label: fig-forest-power
#| fig-cap: "Forest plot of power estimates (point ± 95% CI) at T/R = 1.0 across all methods and sample sizes."
fig6 = Figure(size = (900, 900))
ax6 = Axis(fig6[1, 1];
    xlabel = "Power (%)",
    title  = "Forest Plot — Power at T/R = 1.0"
)

forest_sub = sort(filter(r -> r.tr_ratio == 1.0, all_summary), [:method, :n_per_arm])
n_rows  = nrow(forest_sub)
y_pos   = collect(n_rows:-1:1)
y_ticks = String[]
y_colors = Symbol[]

row_idx = 0
for m in METHODS_LIST
    sub_m = sort(filter(r -> r.method == m, forest_sub), :n_per_arm)
    for r in eachrow(sub_m)
        row_idx += 1
        push!(y_ticks, "$(r.method), n=$(r.n_per_arm)")
        push!(y_colors, METHOD_COLORS[findfirst(==(m), METHODS_LIST)])
    end
end

ax6.yticks = (y_pos, y_ticks)
ax6.yticklabelsize = 10

for (i, r) in enumerate(eachrow(forest_sub))
    y = y_pos[i]
    mc = METHOD_COLORS[findfirst(==(r.method), METHODS_LIST)]
    errorbars!(ax6, [r.mean_rate], [y], [r.mean_rate - r.ci_lo], [r.ci_hi - r.mean_rate];
        direction = :x, color = mc, linewidth = 2, whiskerwidth = 6)
    scatter!(ax6, [r.mean_rate], [y];
        color = mc, markersize = 10, marker = :circle)
end

vlines!(ax6, [80.0]; color = :gray, linestyle = :dash, linewidth = 1)
fig6
```

# Heatmap of Mean Pass Rates

```{julia}
#| label: fig-heatmaps
#| fig-cap: "Heatmap of mean BE pass rates (with CI width annotation) by sample size and T/R ratio."
fig7 = Figure(size = (1400, 900))

for (idx, m) in enumerate(METHODS_LIST)
    row = (idx - 1) ÷ 2 + 1
    col = (idx - 1) % 2 + 1

    sub = filter(r -> r.method == m, all_summary)
    mat_mean = zeros(length(SAMPLE_SIZES), length(TR_RATIOS))
    mat_ci   = zeros(length(SAMPLE_SIZES), length(TR_RATIOS))

    for (i, n) in enumerate(SAMPLE_SIZES), (j, tr) in enumerate(TR_RATIOS)
        r = filter(r -> r.n_per_arm == n && r.tr_ratio == tr, sub)
        if nrow(r) > 0
            mat_mean[i, j] = r.mean_rate[1]
            mat_ci[i, j]   = r.ci_hi[1] - r.ci_lo[1]
        else
            mat_mean[i, j] = NaN
            mat_ci[i, j]   = NaN
        end
    end

    ax = Axis(fig7[row, col];
        xlabel = "T/R Ratio",
        ylabel = "Subjects per Arm",
        title  = "$m Method",
        xticks = (1:length(TR_RATIOS), string.(TR_RATIOS)),
        yticks = (1:length(SAMPLE_SIZES), string.(SAMPLE_SIZES))
    )

    hm = heatmap!(ax, 1:length(TR_RATIOS), 1:length(SAMPLE_SIZES), mat_mean';
        colormap = :RdYlGn, colorrange = (0, 100)
    )

    for (i, n) in enumerate(SAMPLE_SIZES), (j, tr) in enumerate(TR_RATIOS)
        mn = mat_mean[i, j]
        cw = mat_ci[i, j]
        txt = isnan(mn) ? "—" : "$(round(Int, mn))% ±$(round(cw, digits=1))"
        text!(ax, j, i; text = txt, align = (:center, :center),
            fontsize = 9, color = mn > 50 ? :black : :white)
    end

    if idx == 2
        Colorbar(fig7[row, col + 1], hm; label = "Mean Pass Rate (%)")
    end
end

Label(fig7[0, :], "BE Pass Rate Heatmap: Mean ± CI Width"; fontsize = 20)
fig7
```

# CI Width vs Sample Size

How the precision of the power estimate improves with sample size:

```{julia}
#| label: fig-ci-width-by-n
#| fig-cap: "Width of the 95% CI for power/type I error as a function of sample size."
fig8 = Figure(size = (1200, 550))

for (pidx, tr_val, title_str) in [(1, 1.0, "Power CI Width (T/R = 1.0)"),
                                    (2, 0.7, "Type I Error CI Width (T/R = 0.7)")]
    ax = Axis(fig8[1, pidx];
        xlabel = "Subjects per Arm",
        ylabel = "95% CI Width (pp)",
        title  = title_str,
        xticks = SAMPLE_SIZES
    )

    for (i, m) in enumerate(METHODS_LIST)
        sub = sort(filter(r -> r.method == m && r.tr_ratio == tr_val, all_summary), :n_per_arm)
        nrow(sub) == 0 && continue
        ci_widths = sub.ci_hi .- sub.ci_lo

        scatterlines!(ax, sub.n_per_arm, ci_widths;
            label      = m,
            color      = METHOD_COLORS[i],
            marker     = METHOD_SHAPES[i],
            markersize = 10,
            linewidth  = 2
        )
    end

    if pidx == 1
        axislegend(ax; position = :rt, labelsize = 9)
    end
end

Label(fig8[0, :], "Precision of Estimated Operating Characteristics"; fontsize = 18)
fig8
```

# Absolute Difference from Fixed (pp)

Power (T/R = 1.0) and Type I Error (T/R = 0.7) — how much each uncertainty
method's estimate deviates from the Fixed plug-in baseline, in percentage points:

```{julia}
#| label: fig-diff-from-fixed
#| fig-cap: "Absolute difference (pp) from Fixed method, with 95% CI. Zero = no difference."
fig_d1 = Figure(size = (1200, 550))

for (pidx, tr_val, ylab, title_str) in [
        (1, 1.0, "Δ Power (pp)", "Power Difference (T/R = 1.0)"),
        (2, 0.7, "Δ Type I Error (pp)", "Type I Error Difference (T/R = 0.7)")]

    ax = Axis(fig_d1[1, pidx];
        xlabel = "Subjects per Arm",
        ylabel = ylab,
        title  = title_str,
        xticks = SAMPLE_SIZES
    )

    for (i, m) in enumerate(REL_METHODS)
        sub = sort(filter(r -> r.method == m && r.tr_ratio == tr_val, relative_df), :n_per_arm)
        nrow(sub) == 0 && continue
        x_shifted = sub.n_per_arm .+ REL_OFFSETS[i]

        errorbars!(ax, x_shifted, sub.abs_diff,
            sub.abs_diff .- sub.abs_diff_ci_lo, sub.abs_diff_ci_hi .- sub.abs_diff;
            color = REL_COLORS[i], linewidth = 1.5, whiskerwidth = 8)

        scatterlines!(ax, x_shifted, sub.abs_diff;
            label      = m,
            color      = REL_COLORS[i],
            marker     = REL_SHAPES[i],
            markersize = 10,
            linewidth  = 2
        )
    end

    hlines!(ax, [0.0]; color = :black, linestyle = :dash, linewidth = 1, label = "Fixed (ref)")
    if pidx == 1
        axislegend(ax; position = :rb, labelsize = 9)
    end
end

Label(fig_d1[0, :], "Difference from Fixed Method (pp, Mean ± 95% CI)"; fontsize = 18)
fig_d1
```

# Absolute Difference — All T/R Ratios

```{julia}
#| label: fig-diff-all-tr
#| fig-cap: "Difference from Fixed across all T/R ratios and sample sizes (one panel per non-Fixed method)."
fig_d1b = Figure(size = (1400, 500))

for (idx, m) in enumerate(REL_METHODS)
    ax = Axis(fig_d1b[1, idx];
        xlabel = "T/R Ratio",
        ylabel = idx == 1 ? "Δ Pass Rate (pp)" : "",
        title  = "$m − Fixed",
        xticks = TR_RATIOS,
    )

    sub = filter(r -> r.method == m, relative_df)
    for (j, n) in enumerate(SAMPLE_SIZES)
        sub_n = sort(filter(r -> r.n_per_arm == n, sub), :tr_ratio)
        nrow(sub_n) == 0 && continue

        band!(ax, sub_n.tr_ratio, sub_n.abs_diff_ci_lo, sub_n.abs_diff_ci_hi;
            color = (SIZE_COLORS[j], 0.15))
        scatterlines!(ax, sub_n.tr_ratio, sub_n.abs_diff;
            label     = "n=$n",
            color     = SIZE_COLORS[j],
            marker    = :circle,
            markersize = 6,
            linewidth = 1.5
        )
    end

    hlines!(ax, [0.0]; color = :black, linestyle = :dash, linewidth = 1)
    if idx == 3
        axislegend(ax; position = :rt, labelsize = 8)
    end
end

Label(fig_d1b[0, :], "Pass Rate Difference from Fixed (pp, Mean ± 95% CI Band)"; fontsize = 18)
```

# Ratio to Fixed

Ratio > 1 means the method yields a higher rate than Fixed; < 1 means lower.

```{julia}
#| label: fig-ratio-to-fixed
#| fig-cap: "Ratio of pass rate to Fixed method, with 95% CI. Unity = identical to Fixed."
fig_r1 = Figure(size = (1200, 550))

for (pidx, tr_val, ylab, title_str) in [
        (1, 1.0, "Power Ratio", "Power Ratio (T/R = 1.0)"),
        (2, 0.7, "T1E Ratio", "Type I Error Ratio (T/R = 0.7)")]

    ax = Axis(fig_r1[1, pidx];
        xlabel = "Subjects per Arm",
        ylabel = ylab,
        title  = title_str,
        xticks = SAMPLE_SIZES
    )

    for (i, m) in enumerate(REL_METHODS)
        sub = sort(filter(r -> r.method == m && r.tr_ratio == tr_val, relative_df), :n_per_arm)
        nrow(sub) == 0 && continue
        # Skip NaN rows
        valid = .!isnan.(sub.ratio)
        sub_v = sub[valid, :]
        nrow(sub_v) == 0 && continue
        x_shifted = sub_v.n_per_arm .+ REL_OFFSETS[i]

        errorbars!(ax, x_shifted, sub_v.ratio,
            sub_v.ratio .- sub_v.ratio_ci_lo, sub_v.ratio_ci_hi .- sub_v.ratio;
            color = REL_COLORS[i], linewidth = 1.5, whiskerwidth = 8)

        scatterlines!(ax, x_shifted, sub_v.ratio;
            label      = m,
            color      = REL_COLORS[i],
            marker     = REL_SHAPES[i],
            markersize = 10,
            linewidth  = 2
        )
    end

    hlines!(ax, [1.0]; color = :black, linestyle = :dash, linewidth = 1, label = "Fixed (ref)")
    if pidx == 1
        axislegend(ax; position = :rb, labelsize = 9)
    end
end

Label(fig_r1[0, :], "Ratio to Fixed Method (Mean ± 95% CI)"; fontsize = 18)
fig_r1
```

# Grouped Bar Chart — Difference from Fixed at n = 30

```{julia}
#| label: fig-diff-bars-n30
#| fig-cap: "Absolute difference (pp) from Fixed at n = 30, grouped by T/R ratio."
fig_db = Figure(size = (1200, 600))
ax_db = Axis(fig_db[1, 1];
    xlabel = "T/R Ratio",
    ylabel = "Δ Pass Rate vs Fixed (pp)",
    title  = "Difference from Fixed at n = 30 per Arm (Mean ± 95% CI)",
    xticks = (1:length(TR_RATIOS), string.(TR_RATIOS))
)

n_rel = length(REL_METHODS)
bw_rel = 0.8 / n_rel
off_rel = [(i - (n_rel + 1) / 2) * bw_rel for i in 1:n_rel]

for (i, m) in enumerate(REL_METHODS)
    sub = sort(filter(r -> r.method == m && r.n_per_arm == 30, relative_df), :tr_ratio)
    nrow(sub) == 0 && continue
    x_pos = (1:nrow(sub)) .+ off_rel[i]

    barplot!(ax_db, x_pos, sub.abs_diff;
        width = bw_rel * 0.9,
        color = (REL_COLORS[i], 0.8),
        label = m
    )
    errorbars!(ax_db, x_pos, sub.abs_diff,
        sub.abs_diff .- sub.abs_diff_ci_lo, sub.abs_diff_ci_hi .- sub.abs_diff;
        color = :black, linewidth = 1, whiskerwidth = 4)
end

hlines!(ax_db, [0.0]; color = :black, linestyle = :dash, linewidth = 1, label = "Fixed (ref)")
axislegend(ax_db; position = :ct, labelsize = 10)
fig_db
```

```{julia}
#| label: fig-forest-diff
#| fig-cap: "Forest plot of power differences (pp) relative to Fixed at T/R = 1.0."
fig_fd = Figure(size = (900, 800))
ax_fd = Axis(fig_fd[1, 1];
    xlabel = "Δ Power vs Fixed (pp)",
    title  = "Forest Plot — Power Difference from Fixed (T/R = 1.0)"
)

forest_diff = sort(filter(r -> r.tr_ratio == 1.0, relative_df), [:method, :n_per_arm])
n_fd = nrow(forest_diff)
y_fd = collect(n_fd:-1:1)
y_fd_labels = ["$(r.method), n=$(r.n_per_arm)" for r in eachrow(forest_diff)]

ax_fd.yticks = (y_fd, y_fd_labels)
ax_fd.yticklabelsize = 10

for (i, r) in enumerate(eachrow(forest_diff))
    y = y_fd[i]
    mc = REL_COLORS[findfirst(==(r.method), REL_METHODS)]
    errorbars!(ax_fd, [r.abs_diff], [y],
        [r.abs_diff - r.abs_diff_ci_lo], [r.abs_diff_ci_hi - r.abs_diff];
        direction = :x, color = mc, linewidth = 2, whiskerwidth = 6)
    scatter!(ax_fd, [r.abs_diff], [y];
        color = mc, markersize = 10, marker = :circle)
end

vlines!(ax_fd, [0.0]; color = :black, linestyle = :dash, linewidth = 1.5)
fig_fd
```

# Ratio Heatmap — Method / Fixed

```{julia}
#| label: fig-ratio-heatmap
#| fig-cap: "Heatmap of ratio to Fixed (method / Fixed) by sample size and T/R ratio."
fig_rh = Figure(size = (1400, 500))

for (idx, m) in enumerate(REL_METHODS)
    sub = filter(r -> r.method == m, relative_df)
    mat_ratio = fill(NaN, length(SAMPLE_SIZES), length(TR_RATIOS))

    for (i, n) in enumerate(SAMPLE_SIZES), (j, tr) in enumerate(TR_RATIOS)
        r = filter(r -> r.n_per_arm == n && r.tr_ratio == tr, sub)
        if nrow(r) > 0 && !isnan(r.ratio[1])
            mat_ratio[i, j] = r.ratio[1]
        end
    end

    ax = Axis(fig_rh[1, idx];
        xlabel = "T/R Ratio",
        ylabel = idx == 1 ? "Subjects per Arm" : "",
        title  = "$m / Fixed",
        xticks = (1:length(TR_RATIOS), string.(TR_RATIOS)),
        yticks = (1:length(SAMPLE_SIZES), string.(SAMPLE_SIZES))
    )

    hm = heatmap!(ax, 1:length(TR_RATIOS), 1:length(SAMPLE_SIZES), mat_ratio';
        colormap = :RdBu, colorrange = (0.8, 1.2)
    )

    for (i, n) in enumerate(SAMPLE_SIZES), (j, tr) in enumerate(TR_RATIOS)
        val = mat_ratio[i, j]
        txt = isnan(val) ? "—" : "$(round(val, digits=2))"
        text!(ax, j, i; text = txt, align = (:center, :center),
            fontsize = 9, color = abs(val - 1.0) < 0.1 ? :black : :white)
    end

    if idx == 3
        Colorbar(fig_rh[1, idx + 1], hm; label = "Ratio (method / Fixed)")
    end
end

Label(fig_rh[0, :], "Ratio to Fixed Method — Heatmap"; fontsize = 18)
fig_rh
```
